name: Black Saints
description: The Black Saints were a greaser street gang based in Chicago, active on the North Side. Known as the 'Sherry-Berry Black Saints,' they were led by Red Barns and hung out along Sheffield from Sheridan Road to Barry Street. Around 1965, two prominent Black Saints members — Mickey and Jr. Lira — left to co-found a separate group called the Aristocrats at Seminary and Barry, reportedly to avoid being mistaken for a Black club. The Black Saints did not rename themselves; the two groups were distinct, though closely linked, and together the Black Saints and Aristocrats were associated with the Seminary and Barry area for nearly 30 years.
